workout.title: Taper sharpening
workout.notes: General draft; primary EASY work uses confirmed Zone 2. Quality requires explicit M2.3 selection/review/acceptance. No automatic fallback. Founder-selected timed replacement. Warm-up exactly 13 minutes; no recovery after final work repetition. The 5-minute cooldown permits walking: it is included in programmed duration, but walking is not running volume. No fixed pace for relaxed accelerations or easy recoveries. Explicit M2.3 source selection and acceptance required. No extra mandatory walking phase is inserted before/after this exact replacement body.

workout.title: 10K final assessment
workout.notes: General draft; primary EASY work uses confirmed Zone 2. Quality requires explicit M2.3 selection/review/acceptance. No automatic fallback. Flat measured course or track preferred. Record elapsed time, exact distance, route/surface, weather, splits, RPE and environment. Disable auto-pause. First 2 km controlled; km 3–7 even sustainable effort; assess at 7 km and increase only if able; commit in final kilometre. Use training evidence to select pace. If unwell/in pain, do not force the assessment; retain an unavailable result and review timing.
